fact: The SAGE MIS is an automated mobile and web-based system in service for the SAGE cash transfer programme, and its Enrolment and Payments modules were upgraded by Development Pathways for MGLSD/WFP (closing report, January 2024).
title: Social Assistance Grant for Empowerment (SAGE) Management Information System Enhancement: Closing Report
publisher: Ministry of Gender, Labour & Social Development (MGLSD)
